<!-- CUSTOMISE PANEL -->
<div class="customise-wrap">
  <div class="customise-panel">
    <div class="cust-left">
      <p class="cust-eyebrow">Tailor Your Play</p>
      <h2 class="cust-h2">Make it yours.<br>Every detail.</h2>
      <div class="cust-step">
        <span class="step-num">01</span>
        <div>
          <div class="step-title">Choose your base</div>
          <div class="step-body">Start with any polo, tee or trouser from the Ka.Sha core range</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="cust-step">
        <span class="step-num">02</span>
        <div>
          <div class="step-title">Pick your print</div>
          <div class="step-body">Select from our signature prints or go with a solid colour</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="cust-step">
        <span class="step-num">03</span>
        <div>
          <div class="step-title">Add your details</div>
          <div class="step-body">Collar, cuffs, logo placement and embroidery options</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="cust-step">
        <span class="step-num">04</span>
        <div>
          <div class="step-title">We craft it</div>
          <div class="step-body">Your piece is made to order and delivered within 14 days</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="cust-right">
      <img class="cust-preview" id="cust-img" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Product preview">
      <div class="cust-swatches">
        <div class="cust-swatch active" style="background:#3a6aaa" data-src="data:image/jpeg;base64," onclick="custColor(this)"></div>
        <div class="cust-swatch" style="background:#c0302a" data-src="data:image/jpeg;base64," onclick="custColor(this)"></div>
        <div class="cust-swatch" style="background:#2a5a2a" data-src="data:image/jpeg;base64," onclick="custColor(this)"></div>
        <div class="cust-swatch" style="background:#c8a0b0" data-src="data:image/jpeg;base64," onclick="custColor(this)"></div>
        <div class="cust-swatch" style="background:#FEC200" data-src="data:image/jpeg;base64," onclick="custColor(this)"></div>
      </div>
      <button class="cust-cta">Start Customising</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
